messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: exhaustive branch-and-bound with interval arithmetic bounds

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "An exhaustive branch-and-bound search using interval arithmetic to bound the minimum triangle area over all placements of 13 points in the unit square will prove an optimal minimum area of exactly 1/120, achieved by the lattice configuration {(i/4, j/4) : 0 ≤ i,j ≤ 4} minus two points whose removal preserves the largest minimum-area triangle. The branch-and-bound tree partitions the square into sub-boxes for each point, pruning a node whenever interval arithmetic evaluation of the 286 area determinants cannot improve on the incumbent lower bound, and the search will close with zero residual gap at 1/120."}
